warp.bot: Use when the user wants to create a billing order, invoice, or quote (Angebot). Prefer items JSON for custom work (name + unitPrice in cents + quantity). Use billItem only when matching a catalog service by name. Supports type "order" (default) or "quote".

description.en: Catalog service/product name to bill. Skip when using items for custom lines.
description.de: Katalog-Service-/Produktname. Weglassen, wenn items für individuelle Positionen verwendet wird.
description.fr: Nom du service/produit catalogue à facturer. À ignorer si vous utilisez items pour des lignes personnalisées.
description.es: Nombre del servicio/producto del catálogo a facturar. Omítelo si usas items para líneas personalizadas.
description.it: Nome del servizio/prodotto di catalogo da fatturare. Salta se usi items per righe personalizzate.
description.ro: Numele serviciului/produsului din catalog de facturat. Omite dacă folosești items pentru linii personalizate.

description.en: JSON array of line items. Custom: {"type":"custom","name":"On-site repair","quantity":1,"unitPrice":8500}. Catalog: {"type":"service|product","id":"hashid","quantity":1}. unitPrice is cents.

description.en: Price mode — "net" for prices excl. VAT, "gross" (default) for prices incl. VAT

actions.prompt: The user wants to bill: {{billItem}}. Available services: {{servicesList}}. Find the matching service and return only its hash ID as a plain string. If no match, return an empty string.

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.

en: Bill a customer for products used during a service call
Generate an order with invoice from team products
de: Bestellung mit Rechnung aus Team-Produkten erstellen

en.question: What is the difference between an order and an invoice?
en.answer: An order is created through the billing system and automatically generates an invoice with a payment URL.

en.question: Can I use products not in my catalog?
en.answer: Products must exist in your team catalog. Create missing products first via Product Create.

de.question: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen Bestellung und Rechnung?
de.answer: Eine Bestellung wird im Abrechnungssystem erstellt und erzeugt automatisch eine Rechnung mit Zahlungslink.

de.question: Kann ich Produkte verwenden, die nicht in meinem Katalog sind?
de.answer: Produkte müssen im Team-Katalog existieren. Fehlende Produkte zuerst via Produkt erstellen anlegen.
